findings.evidence: StronglyContinuous.lean:64 proves continuous_quotient_apply without unitarity; KernelCokernel.lean:112 specializes it to the cokernel. Mathlib's FiniteDimension.lean:531 supplies continuous_clm_apply, Group/Quotient.lean:433 supplies the normed quotient for a closed submodule, and Fredholm/Basic.lean:125–127 supplies closed range and finite-dimensional cokernel.
findings.fix: Prove continuous_cokerRepresentation over a complete nontrivially normed field and a monoid, assuming closed range and finite-dimensional cokernel, using continuous_iff_continuous_apply.mpr (T.continuous_cokerRepresentation_apply hρc). Derive the Fredholm version from hT.isClosed_range and hT.finite_coker without unitarity or completeness of F.
findings.issue: Both continuous_cokerRepresentation and continuous_cokerRepresentation_of_isFredholm unnecessarily require unitarity, a group, and an inner product; the former also requires an orthogonal projection. This excludes strongly continuous nonunitary actions on normed spaces.

summary: The cokernel continuity results impose unnecessary unitary and Hilbert space assumptions; strong continuity descends directly to the finite-dimensional quotient.
